title: harness_commit CSV stamp ignores dirty working tree
symptom: Batch CSV and telem-v2 rows recorded git HEAD only while measurement harness code on disk differed (e.g. F1F2-1k batches stamped 9c20c0f during DEF-M-009 telem fix on an uncommitted tree).
root_cause: diagnostics-batch.cjs harnessCommit() used `git rev-parse HEAD` only; uncommitted harness changes were not reflected in row metadata.
resolution: scripts/harness-commit.cjs stamps HEAD when clean, else `HEAD+w{sha256(diff+porcelain)[:16]}`. Future batches use this; existing rows are annotated via audit script, not rewritten.

affected_artifacts.note: Ran with DEF-M-009 fix on dirty tree atop 9c20c0f; shipped fix in a76d0d1 / artifacts fa9c235
